_comment: Shared, cross-implementation deep-link route vectors (ADR 0029 §5, issue #1267).
One hand-authored file consumed by every parser and by the backend's emitter
web service-worker notificationclick target resolver, and
backend/services/deep_link_vectors_test.go. A route added to one client without a
vector, or a vector one client fails, breaks that client's build.
Each vector: `uri` is the input; `android_route` is the NavHost route the Android
client resolves it to (or null when it must reject the input); `web_path` is the
path on the user's own server (or null when it must reject). A route may be null
for one client when that client degrades to a nearest parent (see `why`); rejected
vectors are null for both. The backend must never emit a URI that is not accepted
integer ids are decimal `1..2147483647` with no sign, `+`, or leading zero; opaque
ids match `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`; search `q` is trimmed, has Unicode Cc/Cf
stripped, and is truncated (not rejected) at 200 chars; unknown query params are
ignored; OIDC callback is auth-only and never navigable.

vectors.why: home/dashboard: the one alias; `home` stands for `/`
contact detail, lower id bound
contact detail: the backend's reminder push emits exactly this (fcmReminderData/contactDeepLink)
contact detail, 2^31-1 upper bound
activity timeline; web has no timeline screen and degrades to the contact page
circle; web has no per-circle page, degrades to the circles list
tag; web degrades to the tags tab of the circles/tags page
household; web has no per-household page, degrades to the list
search: Android opens the contact list with the query, web its search page
empty query opens the plain list, not an error
q is truncated to 200 characters, not rejected
Unicode Cc/Cf control and format characters are stripped from q (BEL here)
unknown query parameters are ignored, not forwarded
wrong scheme: only `mycorrhizal` is the app scheme
wrong scheme: `mycorrhizal2` is not the app scheme
unknown host: settings is deliberately not navigable (ADR 0029 §2)
contact host with no id segment
contact id 0 is below the 1..2^31-1 range
negative id: no sign is allowed
leading `+` is not allowed (strict decimal form)
leading zero is not allowed (strict decimal form)
contact id above 2^31-1
contact id must be decimal digits
write/edit screens are not navigable (ADR 0029 §2)
extra path segment after activities
empty path segment
path segment decodes to `..`
empty opaque id
opaque id decodes to contain `/`
opaque id longer than 128 characters
space is outside the opaque-id `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]` set
OIDC return is auth-only and is not a navigation route (ADR 0029 §2)
hosts are matched case-sensitively; `HOME` is not `home`
